description: A balanced article with six sections, enough depth for explanation and implementation guidance.
writing_guidance: Develop the topic in a logical sequence, vary the section rhythm, and keep every section useful to the reader's decision or task.
tone: Professional, approachable, explanatory, and action oriented.
expertise_level: Written for an informed beginner or intermediate business reader without assuming specialist knowledge.
conclusion_guidance: Connect the major ideas and give the reader a confident, realistic next action.
avoid: repeating the same advice across sections
filler used only to extend length
invented guarantees, benchmarks, or performance targets
technical detail that does not help the reader act

sections.content_instruction: Introduce the reader's situation and explain the practical outcome of reading the article.
Define the subject, supply the necessary context, and explain why it matters.
Develop the major requirements, tradeoffs, or decision factors in useful detail.
Present a clear method, framework, sequence, or set of recommendations.
Explain common failure points, quality checks, and meaningful signs of progress.
Bring the guidance together and finish with a relevant next action.
